# VranceFlex
> VranceFlex is an agent-led B2B prospect research and outreach-orchestration workspace. It turns a product website or description into market context, verified prospects, personalized drafts, explicit human approval, and one-shot or recurring delivery through provider accounts owned by the customer.

## Start here
- [Product overview](https://vranceflex.online/product): The complete workflow from market research to approved provider delivery.
- [Guided demo](https://vranceflex.online/demo): A fixed-data walkthrough that makes no paid research or provider calls.
- [Pricing](https://vranceflex.online/pricing): Plans based on successfully verified prospects, with BYOK delivery excluded from subscription charges.
- [Trust](https://vranceflex.online/trust): Security, responsible outreach, and provider-ownership boundaries.

## Product capabilities
- [Market and ICP research](https://vranceflex.online/product/market-research): Converts an offer into observable audience criteria and durable campaign context.
- [Lead verification](https://vranceflex.online/product/lead-verification): Separates candidates from usable verified prospects and explains credit consumption.
- [Eve personalization](https://vranceflex.online/product/eve-personalization): Prepares channel-aware drafts from approved context and verified lead evidence.
- [Human approval](https://vranceflex.online/product/human-approval): Keeps generation, approval, scheduling, and provider delivery as separate states.
- [Recurring schedules](https://vranceflex.online/product/recurring-schedules): Uses Eve dispatch with idempotent delivery jobs, pause, resume, suppression, and daily caps.

## Integrations
- [Parallel](https://vranceflex.online/integrations/parallel): Live candidate discovery and selected-contact verification.
- [Resend](https://vranceflex.online/integrations/resend): Approved email through a workspace-owned Resend account.
- [Twilio](https://vranceflex.online/integrations/twilio): Approved SMS through a workspace-owned Twilio account.

## Key facts
- A candidate is not represented as a verified prospect until the required usable contact information is successfully returned.
- One customer credit is consumed for one successful usable verification; failed verification releases the reservation.
- Generated email and SMS remain drafts until an authorized workspace user approves them.
- Delivery remains BYOK: email uses the workspace's Resend account and SMS uses the workspace's Twilio account.
- One-shot and recurring work share suppression, usable-channel, daily-cap, and idempotency safeguards.
- A message is recorded as sent only after the connected provider returns a real result.

## Content policy
Customer-detail and comparison pages are not published without approved evidence. `/customers` is excluded from indexing until real customer-approved outcomes are available. VranceFlex does not publish invented testimonials, anonymous logos, or unsupported competitor claims.
